# Peck

> Peck is a friendly calorie and macro coach for iPhone. Describe a meal in your own words or snap a photo, and Peck estimates calories, protein, carbs and fat, then talks you through your day. No account; data lives in the user's own iCloud.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kelvinharron.github.io/peck-website/): What Peck is, how logging works, Free and Plus, and the FAQ.
- [Privacy policy](https://kelvinharron.github.io/peck-website/privacy-policy.html): How Peck handles data (also in Spanish, Catalan, French and Portuguese).
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760778069): Download Peck for iPhone.
